messages:
Ruth (infra): Following up from the GPU postmortem — creating a single tracked thread for remediation items and owners. Short notes only.
Sam (sre): Thanks. Can we list concrete acceptance criteria per item so we can close them cleanly?
Ruth (infra): Yep. Below are action items + AC. Please confirm owners and dates. I'll nudge weekly.

ACTION LIST (summary):
B1. Quota backstop policy + immediate hard-block: owner = Sam (sre); due = 2026-04-04; acceptance = policy enforced in prod + unit test + PagerDuty escalate if allocation rejected more than 3 times in 1m; notes = differentiate dedicated_reserved vs spot_backfill.
B2. Scheduler pre-warm + eviction cooldowns: owner = Viv (scheduler); due = 2026-04-01; acceptance = staging run shows <5% regressions and spike absorb without global preempt storms; notes = add prewarm API + extend eviction_cooldown to 90s for GPUs.
B3. Headroom forecasting (simple ML) + dashboard: owner = Ibrahim (capacity); due = 2026-04-14; acceptance = forecasting MAPE <15% over 24h horizons + dashboard panel + runbook step; notes = prototype with 1 region first.
B4. Quota-borrow workflow for transient surges: owner = Ruth (infra) + oncall approval flow; due = 2026-04-10; acceptance = documented flow + one simulated borrow drill; notes = add 1-click approve via OpsBot for low-risk warms.
B5. Autoscale cooldown and burst limits tuning: owner = Viv; due = 2026-03-31; acceptance = no oscillations in canary + metrics stable; notes = add rate-limiter on scale-ups and cap bursts to 20% per 5m.
B6. Postmortem tagging and metric: owner = Sam + Ibrahim; due = 2026-04-06; acceptance = incidents tagged "capacity-followup" and weekly report showing pre/post event counts; notes = store event metadata for quarterly reviews.

Sam (sre): I'll take B1 and B6. For B1 I'll implement the hard-block rule that rejects allocs when reserved_pool_usage >= 96% (exclude spot). Will add a short runbook and an automated test.
Viv (scheduler): Taking B2 and B5. Plan: add prewarm endpoint to scheduler API that can be invoked by the surge detector; adjust eviction cooldown to 90s. I'll run stress tests in staging 2026-03-28 and report.
Ibrahim (capacity): Taking B3 and support B6. I'll kick off a lightweight prediction model using EWMA + day-of-week factor and expose headroom_predict metric. Target prototype by 2026-04-07.
Ruth (infra): B4 I'll own the workflow and the OpsBot hook for one-click borrow approval. OpsBot, can you expose a confirmation step and audit link?
OpsBot: automated-message: added slash command "/ops borrow-approve" and audit logging. I will annotate incidents created by automated detectors with tag "surge-automated".
Sam (sre): Quick Q: does B1's hard-block need an override for emergency ops? If yes, how to gate it?
Ruth (infra): Yes — include a time-limited override token (10min) that requires 2-person approval recorded in audit log. Add to runbook.
Viv (scheduler): Note on B5: I'll implement a soft rate limiter that blocks more than +20% capacity change for any single model queue within 5m. This prevents noisy neighbors from causing global churn.
Ibrahim (capacity): For B3 forecasting: I'll use past 14d windows with EWMA baseline, add feature for recent latency spikes that correlate with burst jobs. Will iterate after first drill.
Sam (sre): PR coming for B1 policy: https://git.redwood/example/pr/5001 (draft). Will add unit tests and canary gating.
Viv (scheduler): Draft scheduler PR: https://git.redwood/example/pr/5002 — includes prewarm API + cooldown change. Staging runs scheduled 2026-03-28.
Ruth (infra): Ops drill schedule: let's simulate a 30% transient surge in staging on 2026-04-08 to validate borrow workflow. Ibrahim, can you include forecast failures in the drill?
Ibrahim (capacity): Yes — I'll create a synthetic load generator and attach test labels so metrics are filtered.
Sam (sre): Acceptance criteria check: once PRs merged, we run a 48h canary and look for no more than 1% failed user requests attributable to infra. If threshold exceeded, rollback.
Viv (scheduler): Agree. Also will add perf dashboard panels for scheduler eviction counts and prewarms used.
Ruth (infra): Weekly sync: Fridays 9:00 PT. I'll post short updates in this thread and mark items DONE when ACs are met.
Ibrahim (capacity): Can we also add a retrospective marker to incident logs so we can query which incidents occurred after these changes? I'll create metric "capacity_after_mitigations".
Sam (sre): I'll wire the tagging with OpsBot once B6 is in place.
OpsBot: automated-message: followup-tracker created with owners: Sam, Viv, Ibrahim, Ruth. Next automated reminder in 7 days. Audit trail enabled.
Ruth (infra): Thanks all. Please paste PR links and small runbook snippets here as you create them. Closing note: keep changes minimal in canaries so we isolate impact.
